Features | Features | Trim wear resistance = hardened stainless steel trim
Features | Features | Maintenance = body can stay in the pipeline during removal of trim parts
Features | Features | Balanced valve plug construction = permits use of smaller, lower-cost Fisher actuators

Features | Features | Trim interchangeability = dimensional standardization permits use of most standard easy-e trim parts

urn:plantdocs:fisher-et-d100022x012:sour.text: (felirat nélkül) (figure): 3D drawing of a cage part made of stacked, toothed plate segments and a sectional detail of a valve fitted with such a cage. Use it to see the plate structure of a noise-attenuating cage and how it sits around the plug.

Figure 8. Metal Seat and Whisper Trim III Cage in Fisher ET Valve (figure): Figure 8: sectional detail of an ET valve with metal seat and Whisper Trim III cage; the BONNET SPACER and the CAGE RETAINER are marked, arrows show the flow through the perforated cage. Use it to see how the Whisper Trim III cage design is built and where the bonnet spacer and the cage retainer are.

Figure 10. Cavitrol III One-Stage Cage (figure): Figure 10: sectional drawing of the Cavitrol III one-stage cage in the valve body; the plug and the slotted cage wall are visible. Use it to see what the Cavitrol III one-stage cage looks like and where it sits.

Figure 9. Typical Balanced TSO Trim (figure): Figure 9: sectional drawing of a typical balanced TSO trim, with the VALVE PLUG SEAL and the PROTECTED SOFT SEAT marked. Use it to see where the plug seal and the protected soft seat are in the TSO trim.

Figure 11. Typical ENVIRO-SEAL Bellows Seal Bonnet and Bellows Seal Assembly (figure): Figure 11: photo of the ENVIRO-SEAL bellows seal bonnet with valve, next to it the removed bellows seal assembly with the valve plug. Use it to see what the bellows seal bonnet and its bellows seal assembly look like.
